title: Worker
description: Worker workflows, profile management, and dashboard capabilities in Rozgar Connect

features.name: Profile Creation
features.description: Upon switching to or registering as a worker, the user must set up their worker details. This includes choosing their categories of expertise, their location (city, area), contact numbers, and uploading credentials.

features.name: Profile Updates
features.description: Workers can edit their services, location, description, or update profile/ID images at any time through their profile management interface.

features.name: Real-time Messaging
features.description: Workers receive customer messages directly. They have access to a personal chat interface to manage conversations, see online users, and reply to customers instantly.

features.name: Reputation & Feedback
features.description: Workers can see their public reputation through their aggregate star rating and individual review feedback left by their clients.

states.unverified: The initial state of a newly created worker profile if front and back ID cards have not been uploaded.
states.pending: The status is transitioned to 'pending' as soon as both 'idCardFront' and 'idCardBack' images are uploaded (either during profile creation or update). This signals admins to review the profile.
states.verified: The admin has reviewed the ID documents and marked the worker profile as verified. This displays a verification badge on the worker's card in search results.
states.rejected: The admin has rejected the verification documents (e.g. invalid/unclear images). The worker must re-upload valid documents to trigger a transition back to pending.

supported_fields.description: Front face image of national identity card for verification
Back face image of national identity card for verification

notes: A worker's user account must remain active (isActive: true) to appear in search results.
Updating profile details (except ID cards) does not reset a previously 'verified' status, but editing/re-uploading ID cards when the state is not verified resets it to 'pending'.
